name: Tonari no Mihoko-san ~Boku no Hitozuma Haramase Seikatsu~
original_name: となりの美穂子さん～ぼくの人妻・孕ませ性活～
source:
Shota was a motherless young boy.
He yearned for the neighbor's wife, a beautiful woman named Mihoko.

It was fantasy from afar until one day it rained.
He had forgotten his key inside and was locked out.
Just then, Mihoko came to his rescue.

She dried him in her bedroom. That was where it began.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109671.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
翔太是一个没有母亲的年幼男孩。他一直暗恋邻居家的美丽人妻美穗子。

这种感情原本只能远远埋在心里，直到某天下起了雨。他把钥匙忘在屋里，被锁在门外。就在这时，美穗子出手帮助了他。

她把湿透的翔太带进卧室替他擦干，而一切就从那里开始了。
